title: One Bean for Each of Us

storyteller.name: Storyteller
storyteller.description: Warm, soothing adult storyteller who reads the book and answers the kids' questions

kid_older.name: Leo (Age 8)
kid_older.description: Curious 8-year-old who asks about the plot and loves guessing mysteries

kid_younger.name: Mia (Age 5)
kid_younger.description: Playful 5-year-old who notices funny and cute visual details, giggles and gasps

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Come sit with us for One Bean for Each of Us.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: Say it with us. Up, up, little bean!

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: <giggle> What would you draw in each pot this morning?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Rafi planted one bean. His cousin Nila planted one, too.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: They tucked the beans under the soil like toes under a blanket.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Every morning, they sang to their pots. “Up, up, little bean!”

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: On Monday, all they saw was soil.

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: Up, up, little bean!

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: Can you point to the blue pot?

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: I see dirt in that one. Is there dirt in the yellow one too?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: The blue pot shows bare soil. The yellow pot does too.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: On Tuesday, Nila saw a green hook in her pot. “Up, up, little bean!”

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Rafi leaned over his own pot. “I wish mine would come up, too.”

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: “Let’s draw what we see,” said Nila. She drew her green hook.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Rafi drew his soil, right down to the little white pebble.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: Which pot matches the drawing with the green hook?

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: <giggle> Can you find the little white pebble in the other drawing?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: The green hook matches Nila’s yellow pot. The little white pebble is in Rafi’s blue pot.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: On Wednesday, Nila’s hook stood up tall. “Up, up, little bean!”

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Rafi drew the pebble again. He left room above it, just in case.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: On Thursday, the soil in Rafi’s pot had a bump. <gasp> A little green tip peeked out beside the pebble.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: “Up, up, little bean!” This time, Rafi sang to something he could see.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: By Sunday, Nila’s bean had leaves as wide as thumbs. Rafi’s bean had two little leaves of its own.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: They drew both again, and Rafi gave his pebble a spot in the picture, too.

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: <gasp> Look at those little leaves!

lines.speaker: kid_older
lines.text: What do you see in Rafi’s blue pot now that wasn’t there on Thursday?

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: On Thursday, we saw a green tip by the pebble. Now Rafi has two little leaves.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: They turned back to the first pictures. “Look how far they’ve come,” said Rafi.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Nila tucked a fresh page under the pencil. “Let’s see what they do tomorrow.”

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Which little change would you add to the last drawing?

lines.speaker: kid_younger
lines.text: <giggle> I’d draw one leaf a little bigger than my thumb.

lines.speaker: storyteller
lines.text: Thanks for reading with us. Subscribe and come back for our next story.
